name: Current
tagline: What progress-pane 0.2.1 draws today, with the same sample data.
mood: Functional and flat: every row is the same weight, sections touch, and the right column drifts.
rationale: The baseline. Everything is here, but nothing is grouped: the header runs into NEEDS YOU, which runs into PLAN; the rules are the only separators and they read as noise; the right column (sha, agent, counts) is pushed by flexGrow rather than aligned to a grid; the footer sits on the signals. The band is one dense string of middots.
